verdict.rationale: Cursor's own docs show the agent taking natural-language tasks and carrying them out across a codebase. Agents build and test features end to end, reproduce issues and verify fixes, and make coordinated changes across a whole workspace or several repos, opening PRs. The same prompt-driven editing works in the CLI, where the agent applies file changes directly. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-file implementation quality; most first-party evidence is high-level marketing or overview text.

support.subject: As a developer, I can describe a feature or bug in plain language and have the agent implement or fix it across multiple files

citations.quote: Agents use their own computers to build, test, and demo features end to end for you to review.
Reproduce issues, narrow the root cause, and verify the fix
updated the Node.js version constraints across the project for better maintainability
inspect the full workspace, make coordinated changes, and open pull requests in the repos it changes
